page.layout: One page of text; running head at top; marginal note at left (Cap. II.) beside the first paragraph; then a centred heading HOMILIA XCIX., then verse-numbered paragraphs.

main_text.p: Cap. II. Dei, Psalm. 19. 119. Benefici sint, Iohan. 15. Matth. 5. Praeterea doceant alij alios pro suae vocationis ratione, Matth. 18. Exod. 23. Deut. 22. Sacrificent laudem & gratiarum actionem, Heb. 13. Seipsos, Rom. 12. Preces per Christi nomen, Ioh. 14. 16. Eleemosynas, Matth. 25. Heb. 13. Hos. 6.
¶ Qui haec praestant, Christiani sunt. Qui negligunt, ex eorum sunt numero, de quibus Matth. 7. Singuli ergo sese examinent, & si quid deest, sarciant, & indies proficiant in melius. Oremus.
main_text.head: HOMILIA XCIX.
main_text.p: 27 Per id tempus autem descenderunt Hierosolymis Prophetae Antiochiam.
28 Et unus eorum Surgens, nomine Agadus, significavit per Spiritum, famem magnam futuram in toto terrarum orbe: quae etiam fuit sub Claudio Caesare.
29 Singuli autem discipulorum, prout cuique suppetebat, decreverunt subsidio mittere aliquid fratribus habitantibus in Iudaea.
30 Quod & fecerunt mittentes ad seniores per manum Barnabae & Saulí.

page.notes: The reading "Cap. II." is a marginal note. Several words in the Latin are doubtful due to the faded print; the Latin references in the first paragraph are only partly legible. The final word "Semper" is printed at the right foot, likely a catchword-like signature word.
